python3 -c '
import json, math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

with open("/work/history.jsonl") as f:
    history = [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def get_pose(n):
    x, y, theta = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    for h in history[:n]:
        act = h.get("requested_action", {})
        turn = act.get("turn_deg", 0)
        move = act.get("move_m", 0)
        theta = (theta + turn) % 360
        rad = math.radians(theta)
        x += move * math.sin(rad)
        y += move * math.cos(rad)
    return x, y, theta

img80 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0080.png"))
# lamp base in obs_0080 at bottom left
mask80 = (img80[:,:,0] > 60) & (img80[:,:,0] < 110) & (img80[:,:,1] > 70) & (img80[:,:,1] < 120) & (img80[:,:,2] > 80) & (img80[:,:,2] < 140)
pts80 = np.argwhere(mask80)
if len(pts80) > 0:
    v_min, u_min = pts80.min(axis=0)
    v_max, u_max = pts80.max(axis=0)
    print(f"obs_0080 lamp base: u in [{u_min}, {u_max}], v in [{v_min}, {v_max}]")

# Let us also look at South wall contact in obs_0073 and obs_0080
# In obs_0073, theta=180 (facing South, -y).
# The floor-wall boundary line at the far South wall:
for v in range(256, 400):
    # check floor color vs wall color
    row = img73[v, 256]
    # wall is white (255, 255, 255), floor is grey (150, 140, 130) approx
    if row[0] < 200 and row[1] < 200:
        print(f"South wall baseboard at v={v} in obs_0073")
        Z_c = 396.8 / (v - 256)
        print(f"South wall dist = {Z_c:.3f} m -> South wall Y = {6.043 - Z_c:.3f} m")
        break
'
